concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-braintree-transaction-search-node]] - Node.js transaction search through `gateway.transaction.search()`, with callback `response.each()` consumption, criteria routes, the preserved policy limitation, refund-versus-credit scope, and timezone-qualified date searches
warnings: Keep the result-limitation statement scoped to the linked external policy; this raw gives no numeric cap, affected-field inventory, or rationale.
Do not treat the displayed criteria examples as an exhaustive field or operator inventory; route operator details to the separate Search fields reference.
Preserve the transaction-type distinction: a credit search includes refunds and standalone credits unless the refund criterion narrows it.
Keep timezone behavior qualified to time values in this transaction-search page; omitted time zones use the gateway account time zone, and returned time values are UTC.
